hypothesis: A decoder-synchronized multiscale branch recurrence plus an exact rational-odds readout can retain teacher branch information beyond static suffix centroids and beat an identically shaped hard-label control after complete model accounting.
interfaces_exposed: NNCP hierarchical branch node and previously decoded branch outcomes to uint15 zero-frequency
kill_condition: Retire the frozen affine and rational-odds recurrence if soft holdout payload loses the matched hard-label recurrent control or if recurrence savings do not repay the model package; do not reopen shifts, ridge, or score range without a new state variable or objective.
promotion_condition: Require exact archive-neutral mature and distant traces; soft student must beat the matched hard-label control at equal capacity, clear 2100 B/M net after all package bytes, and then pass native arithmetic replay, roundtrip, determinism, runtime, and memory.
rejection_reason: Frozen startup holdout: affine soft recurrent loses matched hard recurrent by 508.672803 ideal bits; rational-odds soft recurrent loses by 527.486407 bits. Hard recurrence gains do not repay package bytes. Recurrent soft state helps its static control but teacher distillation and standalone economics fail.
title: NNCP decoded-state recurrent branch student
